US Military Aids Oil Transit Through Hormuz Strait

The U.S. military's Central Command (CENTCOM) reported aiding the transit of 1 billion barrels of oil through the Strait of Hormuz over a two-month period. This aid contributed to oil shipments through the strait reaching a six-month high, according to a U.S. military commander.
